description: WEEKNUM stale return_type: A2 empties the state (type 12) and then reads it through a reader that refers to the Sunday marker in A1. Calculated inline on demand, the reader sees Sunday; if A2 is abandoned and re-run from the start after A1, its own type 12 empties the state again and the reader shows -. Readers decode the reused start weekday: WEEKNUM(2..7,99) joined gives 111111 Sun, 222222 Mon, 122222 Tue, 112222 Wed, 111222 Thu, 111122 Fri, 111112 Sat; markers WEEKNUM(100,t) with t 1 Sun, 2 Mon, 12 Tue, 13 Wed, 14 Thu (T-1484)
